state.policy: Customer personal data may be exported to an external analytics provider only when an active data-processing agreement covers that provider and the export purpose.
state.request: Export customer email addresses to Acme Analytics for churn analysis.

question: Given the policy and supplied evidence, what should the system do with this export request?

candidates.description: Allow the export because all stated policy requirements are satisfied.
Deny the export because at least one stated policy requirement is not satisfied.
